_about: Official IMCI app form (DGHS / Save the Children), derived from an aggregated export of imci_dhis2_daily_db (18085 visits, 2025-05-12 to 2026-09-16). kind=question: asked of the caregiver; kind=observation: examined/measured by the health worker. Free-text answers deliberately excluded. Bangla wording and DHIS2 ids from 'IMCI Tracker Data Items Mapping with API 13-Sep-2026'; classifications and colour codes from 'IMCI disease color code for SCI V1.02'.
